_doc: Terms SMG avoids, each with the preferred term and the source. scripts/check_vocabulary.py applies them to diffs, commit messages and the guide's own text. `level` error = a reviewer would reject it (stated in SMG's docs); warn = the guide's own addition for generated-sounding prose, tune after checking SMG's usage. `scope` all | prose | code. `allow` regexes exempt a line (CI matrix legs are not PD legs). `regex` overrides the default whole-word match of `term`.

terms.replace: side (the prefill side / the decode side), role (WorkerRole), or pool (the workers of one role)
terms.why: CONTRIBUTING.md PD vocabulary: 'leg' meant all three at once and does not come back in code, comments, test names or log lines

terms.replace: side, role or pool (a match arm is fine)
terms.why: guide-added at the maintainers' request: no written SMG rule, but 'arm' for a side of a dispatch is as vague as 'leg'; a match arm is fine
